raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (377 rows, ingested 2026-01-18) arrived with txn_ts in UTC (source_tz='UTC'), while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time. Its 12:00 UTC start equals 06:00 CST, and its late-evening transactions spill into 00:00-05:00 on 2026-01-18 when read as local time. This misplaces those transactions on the wrong date and hour across silver and gold, so silver should convert UTC rows to America/Chicago local time using the per-row source_tz.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
